errors.evidence: The tick marks are at 100k, 175k, and 250k, which means they are spaced by 75k units, not 50k.
The blue line representing the 'universal' tokenizer is clearly increasing throughout the plot, not decreasing.
The blue 'universal' line ends at an accuracy of approximately 41.9% at 250k, not 41.2%. The value 41.2 is closer to its value at 175k.
The orange 'cluster' line begins at an accuracy of approximately 41.6% at 100k, which is significantly different from the stated 41.3%.
The orange 'cluster' line ends at an accuracy of approximately 41.4% at 250k, not 41.8%. The value 41.8 is closer to the end point of the other line ('universal').
The description omits the data point at 175k for both lines. This point is crucial for understanding the trend, especially for the 'cluster' line which rises from 100k to 175k before falling to 250k.
The description does not mention the marker shapes used for each tokenizer (star for 'universal' and circle for 'cluster'), which are explicitly shown in the legend.
